No confirmation or success/failure list update recovered for the conversation remove action.

official_observations.conclusion: The actual conversation-row context menu exposes Remove from project only when its supplied remove callback is nonnil; action capture retains the exact current GizmoConversation, not project ID alone.

current_host.observation: Current project frontend supports project creation/edit/delete/pinning and creating/opening scoped project conversations. Project conversation rows have no remove-from-project operation contract or supplied context menu callback. Existing project deletion and Chat catalog deletion must not be reused as this action.

source_backed_now: Keep actual native per-conversation context menu producer and optional callback gate separate from project actions or Remote row menus.
Preserve the acted-on full conversation identity with its project/account scope when an explicit future callback is supplied.
Reuse exact Remove from project label and notebook-badge-xmark resource only for that supplied capability.
not_admitted_as_original_recovery: Unconditionally enabling Remove from project for all current fixture conversations
Using delete project, archive conversation or delete conversation to satisfy remove-from-project
Reusing file Remove from project? confirmation from matching text
Removing a row or announcing success before a scoped operation receipt
safe_product_decision.minimum_independent_option: If the parent elects to implement now, it must be a clearly independent project-membership removal contract: optional capability, account/project/conversation/request/revision identity, separate success/failure receipt and no global Chat deletion. Its confirmation policy cannot be labeled original. This read-only report does not implement or test that contract.
safe_product_decision.recommendation: Defer the visible action until final owner is closed or a complete explicitly independent adapter is authorized/implemented. Preserve the precise callback boundary instead of adding an inferred destructive operation.
